Class Repository<T extends SerializableModel>

java.lang.Object
model.repository.Repository<T>
public class Repository<T extends SerializableModel> extends Object
this class is pretty interesting, because it provides CRUD and serialization for many objects at once. we can pass any *.class variable to its constructor, and database will automatically create storage for this *.class interesting fact, i made 3 refactors because i didnt like previous repository layers
